items.title: Legs are thick, knee-less columns
items.evidence: 5_reference.jpg side/front rows: legs slimmer than before but az090 thigh still runs near-straight to the foot with no clear forward knee; 2_closeups hind limb shows a bend but not three distinct masses.

items.title: Eyes too small and set too deep
items.evidence: 1_beauty.jpg az000 and hero: large yellow almond eyes with slit pupils, flush with the cheek, readable at thumbnail size and the first thing the face says.

items.title: Brow overhang reads as cap/hood brim
items.evidence: 1_beauty.jpg az090/hero: forehead flows into the brow better with no heavy black band, but 3_tech.jpg hero/az090 and 4_posed.jpg wire still show a brim-like step shelf above the eye.

items.title: Hands are stub mitts
items.evidence: 1_beauty.jpg az000: hands are longer with visible white claws, but read as tapered paddles rather than three spread clawed fingers; hero claws are visible; 4_posed attack_f006 fingers follow the swipe, drift 0 in techqa.json.
